old_caption: The video captures a close-up shot of a burning cigarette, with smoke rising upwards against a blurred background. The cigarette is positioned centrally in the frame, drawing immediate attention to its details. The smoke appears wispy and delicate, curling gently as it ascends into the air. The background is out of focus, featuring indistinct shapes and colors that suggest an indoor setting, possibly a bar or a similar environment. The lighting is dim, creating a moody atmosphere. As the video progresses, there are no significant changes in the position of the cigarette or the smoke; the scene remains static, emphasizing the solitary act of smoking. The overall tone of the video is contemplative and somewhat somber, reflecting the quiet solitude often associated with such moments.

caption: The video captures a close-up of a single cigarette standing upright against a dark, blurred background with fixed bokeh lights. Its lit tip, capped by ash, emits a thin smoke column that rises and shifts shape, drifting right, billowing left, and forming faint diagonal streaks. The plume meanders above the ember while the white shaft stays fixed in the frame. The smoke then becomes thinner and less visible, fading from view for the remaining frames. The burning tip and ash cap remain present, showing only subtle texture changes. Out-of-focus lights in the background stay in place, including a pale blue circle at left and a large white blur at right. A small warm spot briefly shifts on the right, but the camera itself does not move.
